defensives.name: Blur
defensives.usage_rule: Press before predictable physical or magical burst for a 20% damage reduction plus 50% dodge against physical attacks; its short cooldown lets you use it freely on incoming tankbuster-style hits.

defensives.name: Darkness
defensives.usage_rule: Drop on the raid before a heavy AoE magical or avoidable damage event so allies inside gain a chance to fully avoid each hit; coordinate timing with other raid cooldowns.

defensives.name: Netherwalk
defensives.usage_rule: Use as a 5-second full damage immunity to soak or survive a lethal mechanic; talent-gated, so it replaces Blur only on builds that take it.
